name: Kamikakushi - Shoujo Nie
original_name: 神隠し しょぅじょ贄
source:
The setting is a village in the countryside. Summertime.
Girls are enjoying their summer vacation. That is, until you sneak up on them in real-time...
It starts with whispering, and surprising, and soon moves on to spiriting them away, turning them into sexual offerings for evil spirits. As a god of punishment, lots of options are available for you to do your work...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE286597.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在乡村的一个村庄。夏令。
女孩们正在享受她们的暑假。也就是说，直到你实时潜入它们……
它从窃窃私语和令人惊讶开始，很快就将它们偷偷带走，把它们变成邪灵的性祭品。作为惩罚之神，你有很多选择来完成你的工作……
